events.description: A stranger washes ashore the lighthouse island after a storm, clutching a sealed note.
Aren drags the stranger to the keeper's quarters and tends to her hypothermia.
The stranger wakes and urges Aren to read the note. Aren recognizes Mira's handwriting.

events.absolute_time: Post-Blackout year 7, autumn equinox + 2 days, night to dawn
events.description: The stranger burns with fever through the third night, speaking Mira's name and the light in delirium; the fever breaks at dawn and she gives her name: Corra.

events.absolute_time: Post-Blackout year 7, autumn equinox + 3 days, morning
events.description: Corra reveals the watch did not break — it stopped at 3:07, the moment the old world ended; Mira keeps time by tides and shadows since.

events.absolute_time: Post-Blackout year 7, autumn equinox + 3 days, morning
events.description: Aren opens the archive and finds Grey Harbor on a pre-Blackout coast chart; he leaves his boat in the water — a decision made without words.
